purpose: Teach: 歓声/一節/サントラ/裏話/夜行/見栄え/新春/旅客機

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、運動会で、本気で、絶対、歓声、絶対、もらったよ
lines.en: Mom, I got real cheers at the sports day. For real, for real.
lines.style: Bright, bursting with pride. Quick open — no hesitation. Chest-forward energy. Slight breathlessness like he's been holding this moment in and it's spilling out. Ends on a lift, seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、本気で、絶対、好きな曲の、絶対、一節、絶対、口ずさんでたわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was humming his favorite song. Really humming it, the whole way through.
lines.style: Warm, observant. Soft smile in the voice. Slow enough to let the image settle. Not making a big deal of it — just noticing what she noticed. Gentle trailing-off like she's still picturing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、サントラ、絶対、聴きたいな
lines.en: Mom, I really want to listen to the soundtrack. Can we get it?
lines.style: Eager but not demanding. Open, direct — the simplicity of a six-year-old who wants something and trusts you with it. Small pause before 'soundtrack' like he's saying the grown-up word carefully. Slight rise at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんから、本気で、絶対、お仕事の、絶対、裏話、絶対、聞いたわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad told me the behind-the-scenes stories from work. Really told me things.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly conspiratorial. Like she's sharing something she noticed — that your father opened up. Quiet pride underneath. Measured pace. The warmth of knowing your family a little better.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、夜行、絶対、バス、絶対、乗ってみたいな
lines.en: Mom, I really want to ride on a night bus. Can we try it sometime?
lines.style: Wistful, curious. The wonder of a child who's discovered something new exists. Soft attack — not demanding, just dreaming out loud. A little breathless at the end, like he's imagining it. Ends with genuine question, not performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママの、本気で、絶対、お料理の、絶対、見栄え、絶対、ほめてくれてありがとう
lines.en: Sho, thank you for saying my cooking looks nice. You really made my day.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude, slight emotional weight beneath. Quiet, almost private — like she's telling him something true. Not gushing. Pause before 'thank you' like she's steadying herself. Warm but composed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、新春、絶対、お年玉、絶対、楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm really looking forward to New Year's money. Really really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Pure, unfiltered excitement. Bright and direct. Quick pace — the energy of anticipation. No performance, just honest joy. Slight giggle threaded underneath. Ends on the lift of genuine delight.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、本気で、絶対、旅客機、絶対、で、絶対、お出張、絶対、なさるわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to be taking a business trip on an airplane. A real trip this time.
lines.style: Calm delivery of something she's noticed — not sad, not cheerful, just factual and present. Slight pause before 'airplane' like she's marking the significance without overdoing it. Quiet, steady. Ends with gentle settling-in, like she's already thinking ahead.
